main_body: Multi-storey school building: a flat green rooftop garden with a light parapet on top, over a cream facade with four floors of windows and a ground-floor entrance
top_band: Green rooftop surface with a pale grey parapet rim, rows ~0-22 (about 20 rows). It holds rooftop units and a blue skylight, and is read from above.
evidence: In a centre column the green roof surface runs about 20 rows, with the lighter parapet band at its front edge. A dark green line and a grey cornice band (rows ~22-25) shade the top of the facade. The cream facade follows for about 65 rows, with window frames and glass inset and floor ledges as grey bands. The large roof area is clearly seen from above, so the top and front are both drawn, though the roof is a modern flat type rather than a sloped one.

style.evidence: The roof has several greens with clump texture and a pale parapet with a highlight. The windows have frame, glass and diagonal reflection in several blue tones. The cream wall is speckled and the brick base is shaded. The outlines are tinted: blue-grey around windows, dark green on the roof, with a near-black door frame. Windows repeat and the wall bands are fairly sparse in texture, so it is slightly less rich than the Beodeul houses, but it is not a flat sticker.
